The Brief

All the rules here

Views update at 11:00 and 23:00 (Paris time). Updates may take a little while.

Official audio file

THEME

No specific theme, you’re free to express your creativity using the required song.

MUSIC

SEM DEMORA by Dj Samir · MXXNAVRA · SIXTINAGER

RULES

- Use the official song provided for this contest
- When posting your TikTok, add the sound using the provided link and set the volume to at least 1%.
- Include the hashtags #theviraleditcontest and #TVEC7 in your Tik Tok
- Mention @theviraleditcontest in the description
- The song may be cut or adjusted for editing purposes, but it must remain recognizable and clearly audible

DO NOT DO

- The edit must be created and posted specifically for the contest, not before it starts
- Using an old edit and simply resyncing it to the contest track is strictly prohibited
- Creating a new account specifically for a contest
- Any attempt at theft or cheating will result in a ban from the platform
- Collaborations are not allowed

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- You can create and submit as many edits as you want
- Submission views are updated every 12 hours
- The jury ranking is based on editing skill and quality, not views
- Virality Prize: Ranking based on the total views from your 3 most-viewed submissions.
- All versions of the song are allowed.
- An editor cannot win multiple prize placements.
- Any editing style, software, and visual universe are allowed

Judging criteria

The jury evaluates each edit based on these criteria, in order of importance.

1
Creativity
60%
2
Execution
40%
Official TVEC rules

These rules apply to every contest, on top of the brief above. Breaking them = disqualification.

Connected & verified TikTok account

Your entry must come from your TikTok account linked to TVEC. An edit posted from an unverified account is not counted.

Respect the theme & brief

Your edit must match the theme, style and instructions of this contest's brief. Off-topic = disqualification.

Official audio & hashtags

Use the imposed audio if there is one, tag @viraleditcontest and add the official hashtag in your caption.

Public video on your account

The video must stay public and online until closing. A private or deleted video is disqualified.

100% original content

Your edit must be new and made by you. No reusing an already-published edit or stealing footage without credit.

Zero view fraud

Bought views, bots or artificial engagement = immediate disqualification. Views are analyzed by our anti-fraud system.

No NSFW, violent or hateful content

Any inappropriate, shocking or discriminatory content is removed and disqualified, without prior warning.

Respect the deadline

Only videos published before the closing date count. After that, entries are locked.

Create an account to enter

Entering is for editor accounts. Sign up for free to submit your edit.
